query: My agent ships in a plugin but its mcpServers and permissionMode are being ignored. Why, and how do I get them to apply?
expected_behavior: Explains that plugin-shipped agents drop hooks / mcpServers / permissionMode for security because of third-party provenance, NOT because of a capability ceiling
States the same agent regains those fields when moved to project scope (.claude/agents/), user scope (~/.claude/agents/), or run via the SDK
notes: Guards against the naive read that plugin agents simply 'can't have' those fields. The cap is a provenance security gate; the fix is changing scope (project/user/SDK), not abandoning the capability.
